notes: Work on multiple projects at once: switching projects no longer stops your running agents — they keep working in the background and are exactly where you left them when you switch back. Plus: agents can now generate images with gpt-image-2 (⌘K → 'Brief agents on image generation'), and you can drop or paste any screenshot onto the canvas as a visual reference your agents can actually see — even by voice: 'use the screenshot and build this'.
